description: Adds a customer, supplier or other third party to a company. Search first: a duplicate contact splits a customer account in two and the aged balance stops making sense. payment_terms_days drives the due date a posted invoice gets when none is given.

auxiliary_code.description: Sub-ledger code; the French FEC reports it.

client_ref.description: Your own reference for this creation. Calling again with the same one returns what was created the first time (`replayed: true`) instead of creating a second — use it whenever a call might be repeated after a timeout.

company_id.description: The company to work in. Ask list_companies if unsure.

name: create_contact
title: Create a contact
